definitions.gloss: worth listening to; satisfying to hear
definitions.explanation: The quality of being musically or verbally impressive and rewarding to listen to.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This song is worth listening to.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a satisfying lecture to listen to.

examples.japanese: ⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だった。
examples.english: The orchestra's performance was truly impressive to hear.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) + {応|こた}え (response/worth) → worth listening to

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (is worth listening to)
- {聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (music worth listening to)
- {聞|き}き{応|ごた}え⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ (fully satisfying to listen to)

RELATED ～{応|ごた}え WORDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え→読み応え：07273_yomigotae⟧ (worth reading)
- ⟦{見応|みごた}え→見応え：07274_migotae⟧ (worth seeing)
- ⟦{歯応|はごた}え→歯応え：07272_hagotae⟧ (chewiness; challenge)
- ⟦{手応|てごた}え→手応え：06635_tegotae⟧ (response; feedback)

USAGE:
Used for music, speeches, lectures, podcasts—any audio content that provides depth and satisfaction.
